title: VUA packages-query result v0.1
description: Result documents for the packages-query v0.1 read face (proposal 024 P1 freeze batch 2026-09-17). The envelope mirrors the standing wire shape (schemaVersion/operation/result, same as project-inspection and project-ops): the envelope const is the word-list-row family version 0.1; the result document carries its own family const vua.packages-installed/v0.1 — the two versions are independent (the c914cf2 standing rule: every wire row cites a version constant of its own). The result of packages.listInstalled is the honest projection of one project's installed package set as resolved from its VPM manifest and lock: packageId, version, and the direct dependencies the package declares, sorted by packageId ascending (the order is a frozen presentation fact the consumer may rely on; it is deterministic, not semantic). An EMPTY packages array is a valid, honest answer (a registered project with zero installed packages) — absence is never padded with guesses. additionalProperties:false on the package row is the false-assertion guard: P2 facts (updateAvailable, versions, source, latestVersion, changelogUrl) have no P1 fact source and a result carrying them is INVALID by schema, not merely discouraged. displayName is likewise absent by ruling: the fact lives in each package's package.json (P2 package-collection territory), the P1 projection type carries no such field, so the word list reserves none (ORC-DEV-004: no implementation, no reserved field; desktop renders the packageId as the display name per its P1 degraded-projection stance).

packageId.description: The VPM package identifier (the manifest name). No tighter pattern is frozen: the word list transports facts, it does not re-litigate upstream id grammar.

dependencies.description: Direct dependencies the installed package declares (sorted, deduplicated by the source manifest semantics).
